# One Booth, Deep in the Forest

<!-- STEP id="gir-booth-story" -->
## A Polling Station for One Voter

In Gujarat's Gir forest lives one registered voter. At election time, officials set up a full polling station for him, so he can walk a short way from home and vote just as every other citizen does.

<!-- STEP id="one-booth-among-millions" -->
## One Among Over 10 Lakh

India sets up over **10 lakh polling stations** for an election, including some in mountains, forests, deserts and islands. In some cases, a polling station is created even for a single voter.

**Why would a country go this far for one vote?**
